Chinese criminal law: "拐骗儿童罪" (kidnapping/abduction of a child). Also possibly "非法拘禁罪". The act: abducted a child, concealed, intending to keep. That's kidnapping/abduction. Also maybe "强迫交易"? No. So crime: 拐骗儿童罪 (kidnapping a child). Also possibly "非法拘禁罪". In Chinese law, kidnapping of a minor is "拐骗儿童罪". So we output that.

No other rules about forging etc. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]拐骗儿童罪<eoa>
